name: search
description: Represents a search or query action. On hover or trigger, the entire magnifying glass moves through a subtle 2D searching arc (left → up → right → center, ±6° tilt, 2.5px amplitude) before returning to center for an 'aha, target found' scale pop (1.08) and quick settle (580ms).

animation.description: Single-group keyframe narrative (580ms, easeInOut): searching arc sweep (x [0, -2.5, 0, 2.5, 0, 0], y [0, -1.5, -2.5, -1, 0, 0], rotate [0, -6, 4, 6, 0, 0]) followed by a target-found scale pop (scale [1, 1, 1, 1, 1.08, 1]). Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: When used in a search input trigger, pair with aria-label or label text for screen reader clarity.
